_template: 08_LIMITATION_FREEZE.json — IMMUATION: once written, never edited; supersession only
_purpose: Freezes the claim's limitations L1..Ln and their arrangement. All downstream artifacts (102, 103, design-around, evidence ledger) reference this freeze's content hash.
supersedes: <previous freeze version, or null if first version>
supersession_rationale: <required if supersedes is non-null; explanation of why limitations changed>
claim_language_verbatim: <the full claim text as proposed to be filed, copied verbatim from the draft claim document>
freeze_author: <agent or human who created the freeze>
content_hash_self: <sha256 of this file, written by preflight after creation>
_immuability_rules: Once written, this file may not be edited.
Supersession requires creating a new freeze version (V2, V3, ...).
V1 is preserved in the repository; never overwritten.
The 102 and 103 attack artifacts reference THIS freeze's content_hash_self.
Any mismatch between the freeze's content_hash_self and the hash recorded in 11_102_ATTACK or 12_103_ATTACK is a CI failure (Section 9.3).
